title: Toward the San Rafael Swell
author: Cary Ravitz
problems: Row 3 "robins allemande right once" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 1 and 3 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 4 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 5 "balance & petronella 1&½ places to a diamond · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 5 "balance & petronella 1&½ places to a diamond · petronella" can't start from where the dancers are: A petronella of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 6 "balance & petronella 1&½ places and turn to face partners · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 6 "balance & petronella 1&½ places and turn to face partners · petronella" can't start from where the dancers are: A petronella of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
The progression after row 6 "balance & petronella 1&½ places and turn to face partners · petronella" doesn't work out: Couple 2 must stand side by side to find new neighbors.
Row 7 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 2 and 3 are too far apart to balance.
Row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 1 "right left through" can't start from where the dancers are: A right and left through needs two dancers on each side.
Row 2 "left diagonal robins chain" can't start from where the dancers are: No couples face each other on the left diagonal.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
